script: Export import business full course? Check four things before you pay.
One: real steps, like ERC, HS code, LC and shipping papers.
Two: real trainers. BFTI brings in experts from NBR, Bangladesh Bank and EPB.
Three: practice on sample papers. Four: no course can promise orders.
Then list your products on Exportain, and let buyers find you.
lessons: 336 chars EN -> 31.8 s raw, 25.6 s after tighten 1.08, final 28.2 s (+0.4 cover = 28.6 s) — keep EN <= 335. Bleed thumb layout hides a centred ship behind the headline band (only sky/sea showed); split with a crop on the container stack works. tx() with Latin text falls back to a serif font — use lat() or custom stamp for Latin. Running two shorts.py voice jobs in parallel breaks the shallow git fetch: voice one at a time.
